overloadPatches.semanticRole: Removes one or more columns (colPosition, optionally number of them) from the list box, addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Removes one or more columns (colPosition, optionally number of them) from the list box, addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
